notes.foundry: Official Model Inference documentation labels 2024-05-01-preview deprecated. Adapter implements documented /info and /chat/completions, with /models prefix on services.ai.azure.com. Azure OpenAI Responses is a separate supported configuration.
notes.manus: API v2 at api.manus.ai, x-manus-api-key; asynchronous task.create, listMessages and stop. Account PII from user.me is discarded.
notes.copilot: Direct Line channel for a configured Copilot Studio agent, not consumer Copilot access.
notes.openai: Official Responses request with store=false; dynamic model discovery; no request retry.
